verses.1: Listen, Israel! You are about to cross the Jordan River and enter into nations that are great and powerful. There will be great cities and strong fortresses in the heavens.
verses.2: A great and mighty people, children of giants. You know who stands before the children of giants.
verses.3: And today you will know that Jehovah your God is the one who will carry out His words. He will destroy them and subdue them before your eyes. You will inherit their land, and they will be destroyed quickly, just as Jehovah has commanded you.
verses.4: Do not say in your heart, “The LORD your God has abandoned them.” Instead, say, “In my righteousness, may the LORD lead me to possess this land. But because these nations are wicked, may the LORD destroy them from before you.”
verses.5: Not out of your righteousness or with your heart full of righteousness do you come to take over their land. For in their sin, Jehovah your God has separated them from you. This is so that what Jehovah has promised for your ancestors—for Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—may be fulfilled.
verses.6: And you shall know that it is not through your righteousness that Jehovah your God gives you this good land to inherit. For you are a stubborn people, and that’s why He has given you this land.
verses.7: Remember not to forget what you have done in God’s name, in the desert, since the day you left Egypt until you arrived here. You will be with God forever.
verses.8: And in their arrogance, they disrespected Jehovah. Jehovah became angry with them and decided to destroy them.
verses.9: On that mountain, I took the stones for the covenant. These stones were given to you by Jehovah. I stayed on that mountain for forty days and forty nights. I didn’t eat any food, nor did I drink any water.
verses.10: And Jehovah gave me the two stone tablets, with all the words written on them. These were the words that Jehovah spoke to you on the mountain, in the fire, on the day of the assembly.
verses.11: After forty days and forty nights, God gave me the two stone tablets of the covenant.
verses.12: And the LORD said to me, “Get up and go quickly from here! Your people have gone astray. They have turned away from the path you commanded them to follow.”
verses.13: And the LORD said to me, “I have seen this people. They are a stubborn and rebellious people.”
verses.14: I will take them away from me, and I will destroy them. I will banish their names from under heaven. I will make you a nation that is scattered and numerous in number.
verses.15: And he ascended from the mountain. The mountain was engulfed in fire. The two signs of the covenant were placed on my hands.
verses.16: And I saw that your sins have been committed against Yahweh your God. You have made yourselves like a serpent, and you have turned away from the path that Yahweh has commanded you to follow.
verses.17: And I will throw them into the two baskets, and I will put them above my hands. Then I will show them to you.
verses.18: And I fell before Jehovah for forty days and forty nights. I did not eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins you committed in doing evil in the eyes of Jehovah, so that He might be angry with you.
verses.19: For I am angry at your face, and the heat that Jehovah has poured out on you will destroy you. But Jehovah heard my prayer on that occasion as well.
verses.20: And in Aaron, Jehovah became very angry and wanted to destroy him. But I will also pray for Aaron at that time.
verses.21: And for your sins, which you have committed by building that tower, I will take it and burn it in fire. I will crush it completely until it becomes dust. Then I will throw the dust into the stream that flows down from the mountain.
verses.22: And in the wilderness and in the desert, and in the places of exile, you will be exalted by Jehovah.
verses.23: And when Jehovah sent you out of the holy land, he said, “Go and take possession of the land that I have given you.” But you refused to obey Jehovah your God. You did not believe him, nor did you listen to his words.
verses.24: I have been with Jehovah since the day I knew you.
verses.25: And I fell down before Jehovah for forty days and forty nights. I fell down because Jehovah said, “I will destroy you.”
verses.26: And I will pray to the LORD, and I will say, “Lord YHWH, do not let your people and your land be destroyed. For you have saved them from Egypt with your mighty hand.”
verses.27: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Do not turn away from this people who are evil and wicked.
verses.28: For they said, “This land from which we were brought out was not fit for them. Jehovah could not bring them into the land that He had promised them. In fact, He hated them so much that He drove them out into the wilderness.”
verses.29: And they are your people and your inheritance, which you received through your great power and through your divine lineage.
